body.content:
I'll take the high finding. We already have a normaliser for attachment names, so the fix is small; PR by Tuesday.

On token lifetime: going straight to 1 hour breaks resumable uploads on slow connections. Can we do 4 hours in 2.4.1 and 1 hour in 2.5, once the client refreshes tokens mid-upload?

Devon
From: Emery Ellis <emery.ellis@example.com>
Sent: Thursday, October 15, 2026 1:30 PM
To: Alex Example <you@example.com>
Cc: Devon Dahl <devon.dahl@example.com>
Subject: Security review findings: file upload service
 
Hi Alex,

The security review of the file upload service is complete. Summary:
  • High: uploaded file names are not normalised before they are written to the log
  • Medium: upload tokens stay valid for 24 hours; recommend 1 hour
  • Low: error responses include the internal service version

Full report: https://example.com/security/reviews/file-upload. We'd like a plan for the high finding by October 23.

Thanks,
Emery
